install Java (JDK 17), the runtime generated apps run on
(operation id: install-java; Manager screen: install)

WHAT HAPPENED
download failed: GROQ_API_KEY=<redacted:api-key> was rejected by the proxy

NPDev Manager 0.7.0: test

python npdev_cli.py setup   (exit code 1, took 5.0 s)

LOG (most relevant lines, redacted)

proxy replied 407 and the vault value <redacted:known-secret> was echoed
error: could not verify the archive

TERMS THAT MAY HELP
- Java (JDK 17): The engine your generated app runs on.

Please explain in plain language what went wrong and give me step-by-step instructions to fix it.
I am not a developer. Reply in English.
